digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration / Pydantic AI compatibility
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model receives ambiguous openai: prefix because v2 will reinterpret it as Responses instead of Chat Completions
rebar anthropic_model and model_classes components emit unqualified openai: targets that trigger the deprecation at runtime
ProviderSession custom-endpoint builder registration and per-candidate endpoint routing gates match only the legacy openai provider name, breaking with explicit openai-chat: qualifier
Replacing inferred and legacy-explicit openai: targets with openai-chat: resolves models without warning and preserves existing Chat Completions wire semantics and endpoint injection

All OpenAI model-construction seams (primary inference, configured fallback, model-class resolution, provider session gates) must normalize to openai-chat: to eliminate the warning and maintain consistent endpoint routing
